body: Replaced Ronin shell placeholder in draw_player_skin_bat. New: draw_bat_head (skull, pointed ears, red eyes, snout), draw_bat_arm (dark articulated upper/lower/hand joints + wing membrane panel that rotates with upper arm via compute_player_anim_pose), custom bat torso with chest accent and shoulder caps, draw_player_leg for legs. Weapon socket and recoil preserved on right arm. Commit a2b01ee SHANKPIT master.
title: SHANKPIT bat skin articulation — draw_bat_head + draw_bat_arm + custom body
